title: JevBench: Metamorphic Coherence Testing for Typed Probabilistic Decision Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.31533v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Typed probabilistic decision models return distributions over specified answers, such as yes or no, a set of options or levels on an ordered scale. We ask whether their probabilities remain coherent when questions about the same input are reworded, negated, combined, given different options or placed in different batches. JevBench tests this coherence without gold labels. Its 50 metamorphic relations each test one law of probability or choice across five dimensions: representation, batch independence, probability measure, logical order and choice-set conditioning. Each test changes the question or batch while keeping the input fixed. Every model receives the same requests, fixed in advance. JevBench-240 contains 12,000 tests across 240 synthetic cases in 12 decision domains. A fixed subset of 1,200 tests, JevBench-mini, closely reproduces the full-suite ranking (Spearman 0.983). translated_title: JevBench：面向类型化概率决策模型的蜕变一致性测试
translated_abstract: 类型化概率决策模型会返回定义在指定答案上的概率分布，例如“是/否”、一组选项或有序量表上的等级。我们探究当针对同一输入的问题被改写、否定、组合、给出不同选项或置于不同批次时，模型的概率是否依然保持相干（coherent）。JevBench 无需金标准标签即可测试这种一致性。它的 50 条蜕变关系各自检验一条概率或选择定律，覆盖五个维度：表示、批次独立性、概率测度、逻辑顺序与选项集条件化。每个测试在保持输入不变的前提下改变问题或批次，且所有模型接收相同的、事先固定的请求。JevBench-240 在 12 个决策领域的 240 个合成案例上包含 12,000 项测试；其固定的 1,200 项测试子集 JevBench-mini 能够高度复现完整测试集的模型排名（Spearman 相关 0.983）。在 21 个公开发布的模型中，一致性得分范围……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: JevBench 是一个无需金标准标签的蜕变一致性测试基准，通过覆盖表示、批次独立性、概率测度、逻辑顺序与选项集条件化五个维度的 50 条蜕变关系，系统检验类型化概率决策模型在问题改写、否定、组合等变换下的概率输出是否符合概率论与选择定律，并对 21 个开源模型进行了评测。
en_tdlr: JevBench is a gold-label-free metamorphic coherence testing benchmark that applies 50 metamorphic relations across five dimensions—representation, batch independence, probability measure, logical order, and choice-set conditioning—to systematically check whether typed probabilistic decision models' probability outputs obey laws of probability and choice under reworded, negated, or recombined questions, evaluating 21 openly released models.
